Frosty-ccino was not found at the Columbus restaurant and is not listed as a menu item; a morning re-check is needed. Calorie ranges (calories_low/calories_high) are shown exactly as on Wendy's site where no single figure is given. Where Wendy's own pages disagree, both figures are shown and flagged, never reconciled. Kids' Meals added 27 Nov 2026 (5 items, $4.19–$5.99, checked 27 Nov 2026 at the same Columbus restaurant, category page order.wendys.com/us/en/menu/173): prices are from the category tiles, item pages show no price; calories shown are the default meal total (Jr Fries + Milk + toy) and change with side/drink choices. hours.breakfast_discrepancy: The location page for this restaurant says breakfast ends at 11:00 AM today (Sunday, 22 Nov 2026), while the national FAQ says the latest breakfast end for most Wendy's is 10:30 AM. Both are shown, each with its own label and source, and they are not reconciled.

breakfast_national.note: National breakfast FAQ — 'most' Wendy's locations, not this restaurant's hours. Breakfast is only served in the morning; check your local Wendy's for its hours. Delivery available in select markets at participating U.S. Wendy's; delivery fees may apply.

breakfast_this_restaurant.note: The location page says this Wendy's serves breakfast and states only 'Breakfast ends at 11:00 AM Today'. No weekly breakfast-hours table and no breakfast start time are shown for this restaurant.

hours.delivery_note: No delivery hours are shown on the location page. It shows a 'Delivery Options' section with four partner logos (not named in the page text) and no hours. The location FAQ says: to find out if delivery is available near you, go to the app or wendys.com/delivery.
hours.dining_room_note: No separate dining-room hours — the location page gives only 'Restaurant Hours' and 'Drive Thru Hours'; it does not label a dining-room table separately.
hours.holiday_note: Only this note is shown on the location page: 'Holiday Hours May Vary'. No specific holiday dates or holiday hours are listed.
hours.hours_note: Drive-thru hours are identical to restaurant hours, as shown on the location page. The page also says 'Opens At 7:30 AM' for Sunday.

hours.thursday_note: Thursday is listed as 'Closed' in both the Restaurant Hours and Drive Thru Hours tables, exactly as shown. No explanation for that closure is given on the page, and none is invented here.
